speaker: Secretary-General
text: Arcadia has identified a suitable offshore location for a new wind park.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: The site offers strong wind conditions and supports our renewable energy ambitions.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: However, the project has raised concerns from environmental organisations, local communities, industry representatives and legal experts.

speaker: Secretary-General
text: Before construction can begin, the Cabinet must determine how these impacts should be addressed.
